findings.where: Interactions list, 'Mobile input size.' rule, tile 1440-00
findings.evidence: The guideline text advises: 'Or set <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1" />', two items above 'Respect zoom. Never disable browser zoom.' The page follows its own advice (sweep zoom_blocked: maximum-scale=1). Readers and agents that apply this document will copy a zoom block.
findings.after: Remove the maximum-scale alternative; keep only 'input font size >= 16px on mobile', and drop maximum-scale=1 from this page's own viewport meta.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.4 Resize Text: maximum-scale=1 prevents pinch zoom on browsers that honour it; the guidance contradicts its own 'Respect zoom' rule.

findings.where: focus ring colour token, every link (dark theme)
findings.evidence: focus.json records 'outline: solid 2px rgb(16, 16, 16)' on all 40 stops; the page background is about #0a0a0a, so the ring is near-black on black (focus/00-on.png shows only the logo triangle, no ring). This is the cause behind the sweep's focus_ring hits: the focus token was not switched for the dark theme.
findings.before: outline: 2px solid rgb(16,16,16) in dark mode
findings.after: In the dark theme set the focus token to a light value, e.g. --ds-focus-color: #52a8ff, with outline-offset: 2px.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (3:1 for the indicator).

findings.where: section headings 'Interactions', 'Animations', 'Layout' ... and 'Vercel-specific', 'Integrate with Agents', 'Join Vercel'
findings.evidence: dom-1440: category heads are h2 at 16px (same size as body bold), while 'Vercel-specific', 'Integrate with Agents' and 'Join Vercel' are extra h1 elements at 24px; the visual and programmatic levels disagree (the sweep counted 4 h1s).
findings.after: Make 'Vercel-specific', 'Integrate with Agents' and 'Join Vercel' h2 and the categories under them h3; size headings by level.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: heading levels should match the visual outline.

strengths: Body links are underlined, so they are distinguishable without colour (1.4.1).
Grey body text on near-black holds contrast; single main landmark and a logical single-column reading order that focus follows.
No images that need alt text beyond the logo link 'Vercel Home'.
not_investigated: dom-1440 records empty text for the h2 elements (#interactions etc.); the visible labels exist, so this is treated as a capture limitation, not a missing name.
Copy button next to the install command (32x32, classes outline-none) was not focus-tested live.
The install command is clipped at 1440 ('--skill web-design-guide...'); horizontal scroll inside a code block is allowed under 1.4.10, keyboard scrollability not tested.
